name: Sunlight Scream: University Massacre
source:
Max returns to Sunlight City, his childhood town to his own brother. A new university, new acquaintances, friends, love... And all the fun comes to end when students one by one begin to die at the hands of a masked killer. Try to survive if you can!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608440/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
麦克斯回到了阳光城，这是他弟弟的童年小镇。一所新的大学，新的熟人，朋友，爱情……当学生们一个接一个地死于蒙面杀手手中时，所有的乐趣都结束了。如果可以的话，请尝试生存！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608440/]Steam[/url]]
